name: a5_carbon_price
description:
OBJECTIVE
    Ablation 5 - EFFECT OF THE CARBON CREDIT PRICE (CCP).
      (i)  grid sweep of CCP (baseline 60 $/tCO2e): coalition value, pooled/private split, practice
           adoption (high-cost, high-sequestration practices such as biochar only enter at high prices),
           solo feasibility, and stability of every allocation rule;
      (ii) BREAK-EVEN prices (exact: geometric scan + bisection on the exact solver): smallest CCP at
           which the grand coalition certifies, at which its carbon revenue alone covers the
           certification cost (p(N) > 0), and at which each farmer could participate ALONE - at the
           baseline budget and with the budget constraint (20) relaxed, to show whether price or
           budget is the binding barrier for solo participation.
